item.title: Leaving Social Media for Good
item.description: In my humble opinion, the way modern social media is being used can't be more toxic. We don't really engage, have fun, or learn. You waste hours of your life doing nothing but scroll through an endless stream of meaningless content. Human lives should be wasted on nothing like this. I won't be talking about why to leave, you are here because you already want to leave.

item.title: The Programming of Wizards
item.description: APL (A Programming Language) is an exceptionally unique language. It mainly follows an array paradigm, unlike the usual functional and object-oriented approaches; it depends heavily on weird mathematical glyphs; and it is surprisingly elegant.

item.title: VIM BRAIN
item.description: [An obscure little project](https://github.com/salastro/vimBrain) that I finished recently was to create an esoteric programming language. My goal was to achieve the smallest possible set of vim-like instructions while being Turing-complete.

item.title: A Linux dead simple guide!
item.description: Introduction What is a Linux distribution Linux distributions usually refers to a family of operating systems that uses the Linux kernel and are similar in some design aspects. For the most part, Linux distributions follows the Unix philosophy and are Unix-like operating systems.
